access_groups.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE access_groups(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

account_plan_batches.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_batches (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
                filename TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, original BLOB NOT NULL,
                options_json TEXT NOT NULL, plan_json TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, state_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('preview','confirmed','reference')), confirmation_json TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,id))

account_plan_metadata.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_metadata (
                company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, prosoft_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(company_id,account_id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,batch_id) REFERENCES account_plan_batches(company_id,id))

account_plan_properties.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_properties (
                company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id), properties_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

accounts.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE "accounts" (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 access_code TEXT NOT NULL, classifier TEXT, name TEXT,
 nature TEXT CHECK(nature IN ('debit','credit')),
 analytical INTEGER CHECK(analytical IN (0,1)),
 requires_cost_center INTEGER CHECK(requires_cost_center IN (0,1)),
 active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 shared_entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES global_account_entries(id), report_group TEXT DEFAULT '', prosoft_code TEXT DEFAULT '',
 UNIQUE(company_id,access_code), UNIQUE(company_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT account_definition_or_reference CHECK(shared_entry_id IS NOT NULL OR (classifier IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND nature IS NOT NULL AND analytical IS NOT NULL AND requires_cost_center IS NOT NULL AND active IS NOT NULL))
)

audit.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE audit (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER REFERENCES companies(id), actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL, entity TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 details_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

auditor_attachments.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_attachments (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        document_ref TEXT NOT NULL, file_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
        UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,document_ref,file_id))

auditor_auxiliary.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_auxiliary (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, document_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_id INTEGER NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
      UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,document_ref))

auditor_catalog_sources.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_catalog_sources (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      preview_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

auditor_catalogs.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_catalogs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), name TEXT NOT NULL,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', source TEXT NOT NULL,
      valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, content_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, published_at TEXT, published_by TEXT,
      review_reason TEXT, source_id INTEGER, reference_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', parent_id INTEGER, UNIQUE(company_id,id))

auditor_findings.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_findings (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', responsible TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      treatment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

auditor_jobs.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_jobs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      mode TEXT NOT NULL, start TEXT NOT NULL, end TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, request_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT, error TEXT, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      deleted_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      finished_at TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, processed_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, parent_id INTEGER, started_at TEXT, UNIQUE(company_id,request_key), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

auditor_logs.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_logs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      level TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id))

auditor_reports.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_reports (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        format TEXT NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL, file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
        UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,format,revision))

bank_allocations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_allocations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title_id INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
                settlement_id INTEGER REFERENCES settlements(id), reason TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, reversed_at TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,transaction_id) REFERENCES bank_transactions(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,title_id) REFERENCES titles(company_id,id))

bank_transactions.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_transactions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 bank_account TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents<>0),
 description TEXT NOT NULL, reference TEXT NOT NULL, external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(company_id,bank_account,fingerprint), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

bulk_deleted_movements.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE bulk_deleted_movements (
        kind TEXT NOT NULL, record_id INTEGER NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
        idempotency_key TEXT, deleted_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind,record_id))

bulk_previews.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE bulk_previews (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
        confirmation_hash TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL)

calculations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE calculations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rules(id), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL
)

catalogs.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogs (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, direction TEXT NOT NULL,
 valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL,
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 UNIQUE(company_id,kind,code,direction)
)

companies.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE companies (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
 name TEXT NOT NULL, trade_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tax_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 regime TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', city TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 district TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', postal_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 ibge TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', ie TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', im TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 cnae TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, profile_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

company_account_aliases.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE company_account_aliases (
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, global_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_entries(id),
            account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(used IN (0,1)),
            PRIMARY KEY(company_id,global_entry_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id))

company_account_plan_bindings.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE company_account_plan_bindings (
            company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id),
            global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id),
            mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('shared','own')), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            attached_at TEXT NOT NULL, attached_by TEXT NOT NULL, copy_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK(copy_scope IN ('all','used')))

company_fiscal_pattern_imports.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE company_fiscal_pattern_imports (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
      pattern_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fiscal_patterns(id), pattern_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, rule_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,fingerprint))

company_operational_settings.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE company_operational_settings (
        company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id), settings_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL)

cost_centers.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE cost_centers (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(company_id,code), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

document_sources.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE document_sources (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,document_id) REFERENCES documents(company_id,id),
 UNIQUE(document_id,source_hash,source_json)
)

documents.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('incoming','outgoing')),
 number TEXT NOT NULL, series TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_date TEXT NOT NULL, posting_date TEXT NOT NULL, period TEXT NOT NULL,
 partner_name TEXT NOT NULL, partner_tax_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL,
 cfop TEXT NOT NULL, total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_cents>=0),
 taxes_json TEXT NOT NULL, items_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 extra_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, business_key TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','reviewed','booked')),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, journal_id INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id),
 reviewed_by TEXT, review_reason TEXT, booked_by TEXT, book_reason TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,business_key), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

exercises.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE exercises(company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),module TEXT NOT NULL,
            year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2199),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(company_id,module,year))

export_batches.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE export_batches (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), period TEXT NOT NULL,
                layout TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, content BLOB NOT NULL,
                manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(company_id,layout,fingerprint))

fiscal_library_versions.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE fiscal_library_versions (
      entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      data_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(entity_type,entity_id,version))

fiscal_patterns.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE fiscal_patterns (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

global_account_entries.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_entries (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id),
            access_code TEXT NOT NULL, classifier TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
            nature TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(nature IN ('debit','credit')),
            analytical INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(analytical IN (0,1)), requires_cost_center INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(requires_cost_center IN (0,1)),
            active INTEGER NOT NULL, report_group TEXT NOT NULL, prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            prosoft_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(global_plan_id,access_code))

global_account_plan_links.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plan_links (
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            access_code TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(company_id,account_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id),
            FOREIGN KEY(global_plan_id) REFERENCES global_account_plans(id))

global_account_plan_previews.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plan_previews (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id), mode TEXT NOT NULL,
            state_hash TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, copy_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK(copy_scope IN ('all','used')))

global_account_plans.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plans (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), source_batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES global_account_plans(id), plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            filename TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL, original BLOB NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(source_company_id,source_batch_id) REFERENCES account_plan_batches(company_id,id))

global_fiscal_catalogs.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_fiscal_catalogs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      data_json TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(kind,namespace,code))

global_fiscal_sources.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE global_fiscal_sources (
      bundle_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

group_companies.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE group_companies(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES access_groups(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            PRIMARY KEY(group_id,company_id))

group_permissions.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE group_permissions(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES access_groups(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            routine TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,effect TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effect IN ('allow','deny')),
            PRIMARY KEY(group_id,company_id,routine,action))

group_users.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE group_users(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES access_groups(id),user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
            PRIMARY KEY(group_id,user_id))

import_package_history.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE import_package_history (
        import_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES imports(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        hidden_at TEXT NOT NULL, hidden_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,import_id) REFERENCES imports(company_id,id))

import_package_settings.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE import_package_settings (
        company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        configured_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), last_run TEXT)

import_package_tombstones.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE import_package_tombstones (
        import_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES imports(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        removed_at TEXT NOT NULL, removed_by TEXT NOT NULL, original_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        history_hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,import_id) REFERENCES imports(company_id,id))

imports.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE imports (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 period TEXT NOT NULL, company_tax_id TEXT NOT NULL, options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 original BLOB NOT NULL, parsed_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
 bank_account TEXT NOT NULL, confirmation_json TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,identity_hash), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

integration_credentials.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_credentials (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 scopes TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 created REAL NOT NULL
)

integration_deliveries.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_deliveries (
 webhook_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES integration_webhooks(id),
 event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES integration_events(seq),
 attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', last_result TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(webhook_id,event_seq)
)

integration_events.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_events (
 seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), resource_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL
, resource TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cost-centers')

integration_limits.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_limits (
 credential_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES integration_credentials(id),
 window INTEGER NOT NULL, requests INTEGER NOT NULL
)

integration_redrives.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_redrives(
        webhook_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,key TEXT NOT NULL,request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        created REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(webhook_id,event_seq,key),
        FOREIGN KEY(webhook_id,event_seq) REFERENCES integration_deliveries(webhook_id,event_seq))

integration_webhooks.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE integration_webhooks (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES integration_credentials(id),
 url TEXT NOT NULL, start_seq INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, resource TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cost-centers')

journal_lines.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE journal_lines (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, journal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 debit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(debit_cents>=0), credit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credit_cents>=0),
 cost_center_id INTEGER, participant_id INTEGER REFERENCES masters(id),
 CHECK ((debit_cents>0 AND credit_cents=0) OR (credit_cents>0 AND debit_cents=0)),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,journal_id) REFERENCES journals(company_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,cost_center_id) REFERENCES cost_centers(company_id,id),
 UNIQUE(journal_id,position)
)

journals.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE journals (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 number INTEGER NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, period TEXT NOT NULL,
 document TEXT NOT NULL, history TEXT NOT NULL, total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_cents>0),
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 reversal_of INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id), reversed_by INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(company_id,number), UNIQUE(company_id,idempotency_key), UNIQUE(company_id,id),
 UNIQUE(reversal_of)
)

lookup_cache.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE lookup_cache (
                kind TEXT NOT NULL, query TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL,
                data_json TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(kind,query,provider))

lookup_limits.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE lookup_limits (
                provider TEXT PRIMARY KEY, window_start REAL NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                blocked_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

masters.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE masters (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
                kind TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, tax_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                data_json TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(company_id,kind,code), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

meta.source_sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

module_imports.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE module_imports (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), module TEXT NOT NULL,
      year INTEGER NOT NULL, layout TEXT NOT NULL, file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, preview_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
      UNIQUE(company_id,module,year,layout,fingerprint))

operational_setting_templates.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE operational_setting_templates (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
        settings_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL)

operations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE operations (
                company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), scope TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL,
                request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(company_id,scope,key))

period_locks.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE period_locks (
        company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),period TEXT NOT NULL,
        module TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(module IN ('fiscal','accounting','financial','social')),
        closed INTEGER NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,changed_at TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(company_id,period,module))

reconciliations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE reconciliations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, title_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,transaction_id) REFERENCES bank_transactions(company_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,title_id) REFERENCES titles(company_id,id)
)

renegotiations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE renegotiations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
                date TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, original_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, interest_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, reversed_at TEXT)

rules.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE rules (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, tax TEXT NOT NULL, rate TEXT,
 direction TEXT NOT NULL, cfop TEXT NOT NULL, ncm TEXT NOT NULL,
 valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL,
 responsible TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL,
 superseded_by INTEGER REFERENCES rules(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, regime TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', municipality TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 UNIQUE(company_id,family_id,version)
)

session_contexts.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE session_contexts(token_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(token_hash) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),module TEXT NOT NULL,period TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(token_hash,company_id,module))

sessions.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
 token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 csrf_token TEXT NOT NULL, active_company_id INTEGER REFERENCES companies(id),
 period TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, module TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fiscal')

settlements.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE settlements (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, journal_id INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id),
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, interest_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fine_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, discount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cash_cents INTEGER, reversed_at TEXT, reversal_date TEXT, reversal_reason TEXT, reversal_journal_id INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id),
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,title_id) REFERENCES titles(company_id,id),
 UNIQUE(company_id,idempotency_key)
)

shared_registration_links.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_registration_links (
            registration_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_registrations(id),
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), master_id INTEGER,
            PRIMARY KEY(registration_id,company_id), UNIQUE(company_id,master_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(company_id,master_id) REFERENCES masters(company_id,id))

shared_registrations.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_registrations (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('third-party','accountant')),
            name TEXT NOT NULL, tax_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', data_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

stored_file_tombstones.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE stored_file_tombstones (
        file_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES stored_files(id), removed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

stored_files.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE stored_files (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, content BLOB NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(company_id,year,category,sha256), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

tax_adjustments.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_adjustments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), period TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
                source TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, document_id INTEGER, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_by TEXT NOT NULL, reversed_at TEXT, category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,document_id) REFERENCES documents(company_id,id))

tax_assessments.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_assessments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), period TEXT NOT NULL,
                tax TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, responsible TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL)

tax_ledgers.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_ledgers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            period TEXT NOT NULL,tax TEXT NOT NULL,assessment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tax_assessments(id),
            previous_id INTEGER REFERENCES tax_ledgers(id),opening_credit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,carry_credit_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payable_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,reversed_at TEXT,reversed_by TEXT,reversal_reason TEXT)

templates.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE templates (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), rules_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL
)

third_parties.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE third_parties (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('organization','person')),
                identity_key TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(entity_type,identity_key))

third_party_company_links.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE third_party_company_links (
                company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, master_id INTEGER NOT NULL, third_party_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES third_parties(id),
                establishment_id INTEGER, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(company_id,master_id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,master_id) REFERENCES masters(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(third_party_id,establishment_id) REFERENCES third_party_establishments(third_party_id,id))

third_party_establishments.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE third_party_establishments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, third_party_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES third_parties(id),
                tax_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, UNIQUE(third_party_id,id))

third_party_history.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE third_party_history (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, master_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                event TEXT NOT NULL, details_json TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,master_id) REFERENCES masters(company_id,id))

third_party_replacements.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE third_party_replacements (
                company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, master_id INTEGER NOT NULL, replacement_master_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                reason TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(company_id,master_id), CHECK(master_id<>replacement_master_id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,master_id) REFERENCES masters(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,replacement_master_id) REFERENCES masters(company_id,id))

titles.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE titles (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('payable','receivable')),
 description TEXT NOT NULL, partner_name TEXT NOT NULL, document TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_date TEXT NOT NULL, due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
 paid_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(paid_cents>=0 AND paid_cents<=amount_cents),
 document_id INTEGER, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, participant_id INTEGER REFERENCES masters(id), source_key TEXT, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, renegotiation_id INTEGER, installment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,document_id) REFERENCES documents(company_id,id), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

user_companies.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE user_companies (
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
                PRIMARY KEY(user_id,company_id))

user_company_access.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE user_company_access(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            effect TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effect IN ('allow','deny')),PRIMARY KEY(user_id,company_id))

user_permissions.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE user_permissions(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            routine TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,effect TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effect IN ('allow','deny')),
            PRIMARY KEY(user_id,company_id,routine,action))

users.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
 password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin', active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_company ON audit(company_id,id)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_bank_date ON bank_transactions(company_id,date)

objects.name: idx_documents_cancellation_identity
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_documents_cancellation_identity ON documents(company_id,direction,model,ltrim(number,'0'))

objects.name: idx_documents_period
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_documents_period ON documents(company_id,period,status)

objects.name: idx_documents_series_identity
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_documents_series_identity ON documents(company_id,direction,model,number)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_journals_period ON journals(company_id,period,date)

objects.name: idx_lines_account
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_lines_account ON journal_lines(company_id,account_id,journal_id)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_titles_due ON titles(company_id,due_date)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX integration_events_company ON integration_events(company_id,seq)

objects.name: integration_events_resource
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX integration_events_resource ON integration_events(company_id,resource,seq)

objects.name: master_tax_identity
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX master_tax_identity ON masters(company_id,kind,tax_id) WHERE tax_id<>''

objects.name: tax_ledger_active
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tax_ledger_active ON tax_ledgers(company_id,period,tax) WHERE reversed_at IS NULL

objects.name: third_party_history_scope
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX third_party_history_scope ON third_party_history(company_id,master_id,id)

objects.name: title_source_identity
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX title_source_identity ON titles(company_id,source_key) WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL

objects.name: access_groups
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_groups(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: account_plan_batches
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_batches (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
                filename TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, original BLOB NOT NULL,
                options_json TEXT NOT NULL, plan_json TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, state_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('preview','confirmed','reference')), confirmation_json TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,id))

objects.name: account_plan_metadata
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_metadata (
                company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, prosoft_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(company_id,account_id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,batch_id) REFERENCES account_plan_batches(company_id,id))

objects.name: account_plan_properties
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_plan_properties (
                company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id), properties_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

objects.name: accounts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "accounts" (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 access_code TEXT NOT NULL, classifier TEXT, name TEXT,
 nature TEXT CHECK(nature IN ('debit','credit')),
 analytical INTEGER CHECK(analytical IN (0,1)),
 requires_cost_center INTEGER CHECK(requires_cost_center IN (0,1)),
 active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 shared_entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES global_account_entries(id), report_group TEXT DEFAULT '', prosoft_code TEXT DEFAULT '',
 UNIQUE(company_id,access_code), UNIQUE(company_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT account_definition_or_reference CHECK(shared_entry_id IS NOT NULL OR (classifier IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND nature IS NOT NULL AND analytical IS NOT NULL AND requires_cost_center IS NOT NULL AND active IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: audit
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER REFERENCES companies(id), actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL, entity TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 details_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: auditor_attachments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_attachments (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        document_ref TEXT NOT NULL, file_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
        UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,document_ref,file_id))

objects.name: auditor_auxiliary
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_auxiliary (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL, document_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_id INTEGER NOT NULL, renderer TEXT NOT NULL, source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
      UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,document_ref))

objects.name: auditor_catalog_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_catalog_sources (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      preview_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

objects.name: auditor_catalogs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_catalogs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), name TEXT NOT NULL,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', source TEXT NOT NULL,
      valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, content_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, published_at TEXT, published_by TEXT,
      review_reason TEXT, source_id INTEGER, reference_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', parent_id INTEGER, UNIQUE(company_id,id))

objects.name: auditor_findings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_findings (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', responsible TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      treatment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

objects.name: auditor_jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_jobs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      mode TEXT NOT NULL, start TEXT NOT NULL, end TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, request_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT, error TEXT, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      deleted_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      finished_at TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, processed_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, parent_id INTEGER, started_at TEXT, UNIQUE(company_id,request_key), UNIQUE(company_id,id))

objects.name: auditor_logs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_logs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      level TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id))

objects.name: auditor_reports
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE auditor_reports (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        format TEXT NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL, file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,job_id) REFERENCES auditor_jobs(company_id,id),
        FOREIGN KEY(company_id,file_id) REFERENCES stored_files(company_id,id),
        UNIQUE(company_id,job_id,format,revision))

objects.name: bank_allocations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_allocations (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                title_id INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
                settlement_id INTEGER REFERENCES settlements(id), reason TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, reversed_at TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,transaction_id) REFERENCES bank_transactions(company_id,id),
                FOREIGN KEY(company_id,title_id) REFERENCES titles(company_id,id))

objects.name: bank_transactions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_transactions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 bank_account TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents<>0),
 description TEXT NOT NULL, reference TEXT NOT NULL, external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(company_id,bank_account,fingerprint), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

objects.name: bulk_deleted_movements
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bulk_deleted_movements (
        kind TEXT NOT NULL, record_id INTEGER NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
        idempotency_key TEXT, deleted_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind,record_id))

objects.name: bulk_previews
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE bulk_previews (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
        confirmation_hash TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL)

objects.name: calculations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE calculations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rules(id), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: catalogs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogs (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, direction TEXT NOT NULL,
 valid_from TEXT NOT NULL, valid_to TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL,
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 UNIQUE(company_id,kind,code,direction)
)

objects.name: companies
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE companies (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
 name TEXT NOT NULL, trade_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tax_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 regime TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', city TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 district TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', postal_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 ibge TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', ie TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', im TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 cnae TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, profile_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

objects.name: company_account_aliases
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_account_aliases (
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, global_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_entries(id),
            account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(used IN (0,1)),
            PRIMARY KEY(company_id,global_entry_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id))

objects.name: company_account_plan_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_account_plan_bindings (
            company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id),
            global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id),
            mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('shared','own')), version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            attached_at TEXT NOT NULL, attached_by TEXT NOT NULL, copy_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK(copy_scope IN ('all','used')))

objects.name: company_fiscal_pattern_imports
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_fiscal_pattern_imports (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
      pattern_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fiscal_patterns(id), pattern_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, rule_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,fingerprint))

objects.name: company_operational_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE company_operational_settings (
        company_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES companies(id), settings_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: cost_centers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE cost_centers (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(company_id,code), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

objects.name: document_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE document_sources (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(company_id,document_id) REFERENCES documents(company_id,id),
 UNIQUE(document_id,source_hash,source_json)
)

objects.name: documents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
 direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('incoming','outgoing')),
 number TEXT NOT NULL, series TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_date TEXT NOT NULL, posting_date TEXT NOT NULL, period TEXT NOT NULL,
 partner_name TEXT NOT NULL, partner_tax_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL,
 cfop TEXT NOT NULL, total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total_cents>=0),
 taxes_json TEXT NOT NULL, items_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 extra_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, business_key TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','reviewed','booked')),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, journal_id INTEGER REFERENCES journals(id),
 reviewed_by TEXT, review_reason TEXT, booked_by TEXT, book_reason TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(company_id,business_key), UNIQUE(company_id,id)
)

objects.name: exercises
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE exercises(company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),module TEXT NOT NULL,
            year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2199),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(company_id,module,year))

objects.name: export_batches
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE export_batches (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), period TEXT NOT NULL,
                layout TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, content BLOB NOT NULL,
                manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(company_id,layout,fingerprint))

objects.name: fiscal_library_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE fiscal_library_versions (
      entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      data_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(entity_type,entity_id,version))

objects.name: fiscal_patterns
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE fiscal_patterns (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: global_account_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_entries (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id),
            access_code TEXT NOT NULL, classifier TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
            nature TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(nature IN ('debit','credit')),
            analytical INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(analytical IN (0,1)), requires_cost_center INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(requires_cost_center IN (0,1)),
            active INTEGER NOT NULL, report_group TEXT NOT NULL, prosoft_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            prosoft_json TEXT NOT NULL, extras_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(global_plan_id,access_code))

objects.name: global_account_plan_links
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plan_links (
            company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            access_code TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(company_id,account_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(company_id,account_id) REFERENCES accounts(company_id,id),
            FOREIGN KEY(global_plan_id) REFERENCES global_account_plans(id))

objects.name: global_account_plan_previews
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plan_previews (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            global_plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES global_account_plans(id), mode TEXT NOT NULL,
            state_hash TEXT NOT NULL, preview_hash TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, copy_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK(copy_scope IN ('all','used')))

objects.name: global_account_plans
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_account_plans (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), source_batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES global_account_plans(id), plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            filename TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL, original BLOB NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(source_company_id,source_batch_id) REFERENCES account_plan_batches(company_id,id))

objects.name: global_fiscal_catalogs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_fiscal_catalogs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      data_json TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(kind,namespace,code))

objects.name: global_fiscal_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_fiscal_sources (
      bundle_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: group_companies
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE group_companies(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES access_groups(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            PRIMARY KEY(group_id,company_id))

objects.name: group_permissions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE group_permissions(group_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES access_groups(id),company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
            routine TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,effect TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effect IN ('allow','deny')),
            PRIMARY KEY(group_id,company_id,routine,action))

objects.name: group_users
objects.sql:

objects.name: effective_accounts
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW effective_accounts AS
            SELECT a.id,a.company_id,a.access_code,
                COALESCE(a.classifier,g.classifier) AS classifier, COALESCE(a.name,g.name) AS name,
                COALESCE(a.nature,g.nature) AS nature,COALESCE(a.analytical,g.analytical) AS analytical,
                COALESCE(a.requires_cost_center,g.requires_cost_center) AS requires_cost_center,
                COALESCE(a.active,g.active) AS active,a.version,
                COALESCE(a.report_group,g.report_group) AS report_group,COALESCE(a.prosoft_code,g.prosoft_code) AS prosoft_code,
                a.shared_entry_id
            FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN global_account_entries g ON g.id=a.shared_entry_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT -g.id,b.company_id,g.access_code,g.classifier,g.name,g.nature,g.analytical,g.requires_cost_center,g.active,1,g.report_group,g.prosoft_code,g.id
            FROM company_account_plan_bindings b JOIN global_account_entries g ON g.global_plan_id=b.global_plan_id
            WHERE b.mode='shared' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts a WHERE a.company_id=b.company_id AND a.access_code=g.access_code)
